name: search_files
description: Search for files based on content similarity. Use this when the user asks about documents, files, or specific information that might be stored in uploaded files.

query.description: The search query to find relevant files based on their content.

top_k.description: The maximum number of files to return (default: 5, max: 10).

mime_type_filter.description: Optional filter to search only files of specific MIME type (e.g., 'application/pdf', 'text/plain').
